implementation: Finite DECLARE_VIRTUAL_BLADE accepts exactly the two canonical ability IDs, one target and optional event identifier; arbitrary numeric/source/card payloads are rejected. Current own-action entry rejects stale event bindings.

virtual-blade-sources.ts registers the two abilities without runtime import cycles. virtual-blades.ts constructs the printed profiles and private candidates, validates current own public live source and near target, and opens a cancellable ordinary ability declaration.

A normal ActionFrame saves source kind ability, actor and ability ID with cardInstanceId null and empty sourceCardInstanceIds. Normal physical attack/counter declarations save source kind card. No sentinel or invented physical card enters the zones.

After the ability declaration, existing action checks, effect/damage freeze, normal defense, maai, counter/reflection and completion run. Cancellation or declaration-time source suppression consumes the attack without source discard or refill.

action-source.ts separates physical action card, physical effect card, source card collection and optional ability damage provenance. Physical-only continuations assert their physical requirement. Reflections retain the original ability provenance while displaying the physical reflector.

Public action projection can show a declared ability technique and its ordinary calculated values. VirtualBladePanel presents available names, printed profile and legal near target only to the owner; ActionSummary and ActionCalculationSummary display the declared source.
acceptanceEvidence: Exact ice near/magic/water Lv4 damage3 maaiRequired2 and fire near/magic/fire Lv4 damage5 maaiRequired1; one group, normal withdrawal, unchanged source hand and no source discard.

Both sources: hidden source, foreign actor, far target, invented numerical payload and stale binding rejected unchanged; owner-only candidate projection and unchanged action opportunity before selection.
Both sources: actual Fate cancellation consumes action, only the real Fate card is disposed.
Both sources: one/two physical maai submission outcomes match printed requirements.
Both sources: actual Ice Mirror reflects the virtual attack with empty original physical source list and preserved source ability ID.
Actual physical Demon Mountain Sword counter returns to the exact saved virtual parent once; no remaining action/group after cleanup.
Actual Vanmil ban during declaration cancels the virtual use without a hit or physical disposal.

Ordinary excess-level before/after rolls, failure and actual God reroll succeed/fail through the existing check path. Lower magic/spirit are initial fixture stats, not a claimed live stat-drain producer.

Every Engine command JSON-replays and conserves 220 unique physical cards. Actual DO restarts and duplicate ACK verification run after every command, including declaration, use rolls, cancellation and resolution.
Browser cases for both sources and cancellation use the actual finite UI; source owner refreshes during declaration and ice use roll. Other participants receive no candidate panel.
resolvedFailures: Optional targetEventId initially counted as a mandatory exact key; parser now includes it only when supplied.
Registering source constants through the runtime factory caused an import-cycle registration failure; constants now live in a dependency-free module.

Physical reflection display initially used the effect source instead of the physical reflector. The established placed-Skeleton reflection acceptance failed; physicalActionCard and physicalEffectCard now have separate purposes and all targeted tests pass.
Fixture reflection/God names were corrected to their canonical known physical IDs; the excess-level fixture lowers ice magic below Lv4 rather than to exactly Lv4.
